title: syllabus of 3rd sem
content:
SUBJECT NAME: Digital Electronics
MODULE 1. Fundamentals of digital systems and logic families
MODULE 2. Combinational digitalcircuit
MODULE 3. Sequential circuit and systems
MODULE 4. A/D and D/A converters
MODULE 5. Semiconductor memories and programmable logic device


SUBJECT NAME: Data structure & algorithm
MODULE 1. introduction
MODULE 2. Stacks and queues
MODULE 3. Linked list
MODULE 4. sorting and hashing


SUBJECT NAME: Analog electronic circuit
MODULE 1. Diode circuit
MODULE 2. BJT circuits
MODULE 3. MOSFET circuits
MODULE 4. Differential , multistage and operational amplifiers
MODULE 5. Linear applications of OP-AMP
MODULE 6. Nonlinear applications of Op-AMP


SUBJECT NAME: Effective technical communication
MODULE 1. Information design and development
MODULE 2. Technical writing , grammer and editing
MODULE 3. Self development and assessment
MODULE 4. Communication and technical writing
MODULE 5. Ethics
